name: U6-IW
title: Access Point U6 In-Wall
summary: In-wall WiFi 6 AP for single rooms with a built-in 4-port GbE switch (1 PoE out).

requires: PoE+ source if using PoE output
UniFi OS console / gateway running UniFi Network (6.0.45+)

gotchas: Only one downstream port supplies PoE, and only when the AP itself is fed PoE+.
Everything (WiFi + 4 wired ports) shares a single 1GbE uplink.
WiFi 6 only — no 6 GHz; consider a WiFi 7 wall AP if 6 GHz clients matter.
Mounts over a wall box; coverage 115 m² — one per room, not a whole-floor AP.
best_for: hotel rooms, dorms, offices with wired desk devices
